2.209.5
Map.CustomProperties
Applies to RDL 2010/01 and RDL 2016/01
The Map.CustomProperties element specifies custom information for a Map that will be handed to a
report rendering component. The Map.CustomProperties element is optional. This element is of type
CustomProperties.
The following is the parent element of the Map.CustomProperties element.
Parent elements
Map
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Map.CustomProperties element.
 <xsd:element name="CustomProperties" type="CustomPropertiesType" minOccurs="0" />
